title: Non-verbal Amazon tribes and their 'ancient language'

tellings.quote: is there's there are apparently nonverbal tribes in the Amazon
In fact, there are Amazonian tribes who they they call it the ancient language and they telepathically beam information to each other
tellings.difference: States outright that the tribes communicate telepathically.
tellings.link_reason: Same Amazonian tribes said to beam information to each other telepathically in an 'ancient language'.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there are apparently tribes in the Amazon rainforest who communicate without speaking. In a later episode he goes further and says these tribes call it the ancient language and send information to each other by telepathy, meaning mind to mind. He brings it up as a sign that people might share thoughts directly.
